en.name: Urban III
en.summary: A pope whose bitter conflict with Frederick Barbarossa over territorial claims left him unable even to be crowned in Rome.
en.body: Urban III's relationship with Frederick Barbarossa deteriorated sharply over disputed inheritance claims in northern Italy, and hostility between them was so severe that Urban was never able to enter Rome for his own coronation, governing instead from Verona. News of the catastrophic Christian defeat at the Battle of Hattin and the fall of Jerusalem to Saladin reportedly contributed to his death shortly after.
